# APEX Skills (Agentic Platform Engineering eXperience)

> Curated agentic AI skills for AWS platform engineering, delivered through any coding agent

## About

- Repository: https://github.com/aws-samples/sample-apex-skills
- Documentation: https://aws-samples.github.io/sample-apex-skills/
- License: MIT-0
- Spec: https://agentskills.io

## Installation

### NPX installer (Claude Code and Kiro CLI)
```
npx apex-skills@1.3.0
```
For v2 and its `/apex` router, use the manual install from `main`.

See the documentation site for full installation instructions.

## Skills Catalog (all 28 skills; the same list is the Skills page and static/manifests/skills.json)

- **apex**: Router for EKS and ECS requests: picks the skill that fits, infers the stage (Day 0 Design, Day 1 Build, Day 2 Operate), carries context between skills and suggests next skills
- **dotnet-aws-ecs**: Deploy a .NET workload to Amazon ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer, with CloudFormation or CDK and a deployment guide
- **ecs-architect**: Choose and architect the ECS deployment model for a new workload: Fargate, EC2, Managed Instances, Express Mode or ECS Anywhere, capacity providers and task sizing
- **ecs-build**: Generate apply-ready Terraform for ECS clusters, services and task definitions on Fargate, EC2 Auto Scaling or Managed Instances
- **ecs-devops**: Deploy and release to ECS: blue/green and canary deployments, CI/CD pipelines and rollbacks
- **ecs-genai**: GPU, ML and GenAI workloads on ECS: GPU instances, Inferentia, Trainium and Neuron, launch type choice, training and model inference
- **ecs-modernize**: Assess an existing VMware or EC2 app from its source code, decide replatform or rearchitect, and migrate it onto ECS
- **ecs-observability**: ECS observability architecture: logs, metrics and traces with CloudWatch, Container Insights, X-Ray, ADOT, Managed Prometheus and Grafana, or FireLens
- **ecs-operation-review**: Structured ECS operational excellence assessment of a live estate across 8 domains with GREEN/AMBER/RED ratings
- **ecs-recon**: ECS environment discovery: compute and capacity providers, task definitions, deployments, scaling, networking, security, observability and IaC/CI-CD
- **ecs-security**: ECS security and compliance: task and execution roles, iam:PassRole, trust policies, secrets injection and shared responsibility on Fargate and EC2
- **eks-best-practices**: EKS design, architecture, and configuration decisions: compute strategy, multi-tenant isolation, networking, IAM, security, cost, and observability
- **eks-build**: Generate complete production-ready EKS Terraform projects with optional ArgoCD GitOps, air-gapped support, and 29+ addon configurations
- **eks-cost-intelligence**: Live EKS cost efficiency assessment across 6 dimensions with a 0-100 Cost Score and dollar-quantified findings
- **eks-design**: Generate EKS architecture design documents with Mermaid diagrams, ADRs, security architecture, and Well-Architected validation
- **eks-genai**: GenAI and LLM workloads on EKS: GPU vs Trainium/Inferentia, vLLM and Ray serving, distributed training, ML storage and AI gateways
- **eks-ingress-migration**: Assess a live cluster's NGINX/Ingress estate and plan migration to Gateway API, the AWS Load Balancer Controller or AWS Transform
- **eks-mcp-server**: Setup and configure the EKS MCP Server for live cluster operations: list clusters, read resources, troubleshoot pods, check upgrade insights
- **eks-operation-review**: Structured EKS operational excellence assessment across 10 areas with GREEN/AMBER/RED ratings and prioritized recommendations
- **eks-platform-engineering**: Internal Developer Platform design on EKS: Backstage, ArgoCD, Kargo, progressive delivery, golden paths, and DORA metrics
- **eks-recon**: EKS cluster reconnaissance and environment discovery: compute strategy, IaC tooling, CI/CD, add-ons, networking, and security posture
- **eks-security**: EKS security and compliance: CIS, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP and SOC 2, cluster hardening, AMI choice, Pod Identity, GuardDuty and image signing
- **eks-upgrade-check**: Assess EKS cluster upgrade readiness with a 0-100 score across 8 areas including deprecated APIs, add-on compatibility, and workload risks
- **eks-well-architected-review**: Deterministic, unofficial AWS Well-Architected style review of an EKS cluster (Linux nodes only)
- **graviton-migration**: Migrate a workload from x86 to AWS Graviton (arm64): arm64 readiness scanning with the Arm migration MCP server, then the migration
- **skill-creator**: Create new skills, modify existing skills, run evals, benchmark performance, and optimize triggering accuracy
- **terraform-skill**: Terraform and OpenTofu: modules, native tests, Terratest, CI/CD pipelines, state debugging, and security scanning
- **update-docs**: Audit and sync all documentation surfaces after skill changes: README markers, Docusaurus site, and prose references
